name: Contract Clause Extractor
headline: Find liability, termination, jurisdiction, and IP clauses in contract text.
description: A span-extraction template for legal-ops teams. Train a small model to read a paragraph of contract text and emit a JSON array of every clause-type span it contains — type, start offset, end offset, raw text. Output drops directly into review queues, redlining tools, or compliance dashboards. Covers liability_cap, termination, jurisdiction, governing_law, confidentiality, indemnification, payment_terms, warranty, dispute_resolution, ip_assignment.
suggested_brief: Train a span-level contract clause extractor. Input: paragraph of contract text. Output: JSON array of {type, start, end, text} for each clause. Recall matters more than precision — missed clauses become compliance risk; false positives are cheap to dismiss.
